_how_to_use.step1: Copy this file to tools/credentials.json (it is gitignored)
_how_to_use.step2: Fill in your credentials for each service you want to use
_how_to_use.step3: Run: node tools/api.js salesforce login   (Salesforce needs a login step)
_how_to_use.salesforce_note: Your security token is emailed when you reset it: Salesforce → Settings → My Personal Information → Reset My Security Token. Append it directly to your password, no space.
_how_to_use.confluence_note: Generate an Atlassian API token at: https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
_how_to_use.asana_note: Generate a Personal Access Token at: Asana → Profile → My Profile Settings → Apps → Personal Access Tokens → Create New Token

salesforce._comment: instance_url is optional — defaults to https://login.salesforce.com (use https://test.salesforce.com for sandboxes)

confluence._comment: base_url is your Atlassian site — e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net

asana._comment: Generate a Personal Access Token from Asana settings
